name: sonar_to_jira_agent
description: Pulls a Sonar findings report from S3/MinIO and creates Jira tickets.

triggers.name: key
triggers.description: S3/MinIO object key of the findings report (JSON) - bucket comes from S3_BUCKET

triggers.name: jira_url
triggers.description: Jira base URL to create tickets in (e.g. https://yourcompany.atlassian.net)
